name: Bulk omics from adherent cells: one cold acidified organic extraction, metabolome then proteome - module6_v1
source: Chip geometry, volumes, flows and durations are ours, derived from chip/module6_v1.json and contracts/. ONE EXTRACTION, TWO FRACTIONS: Coman et al. 2016 (SIMPLEX), doi:10.1074/mcp.M115.053702, and Sapcariu et al. 2014, doi:10.1016/j.mex.2014.07.002 - cited for the PRINCIPLE (metabolites in the supernatant, protein in the pellet) and for the >=5 min cold soak, NOT for depth or CV figures: Sapcariu is a chloroform/Folch-type biphasic partition and SIMPLEX an ether-based one, while this chip runs a single-phase acidified polar-organic precipitation with no partition solvent at all, so quantitative transfer from either is an ASSUMPTION. EXTRACTION ON ADHERENT CELLS: Dettmer et al. 2011, doi:10.1007/s00216-010-4425-x (direct cold solvent on adherent cells beat scrape-in-buffer 7x). THE RINSE: Lorenz et al. 2011, doi:10.1021/ac103313x (a quick rinse roughly doubles detected features) says rinse; Kapoore et al. 2017, doi:10.1039/C7AN00207F (washing causes metabolite leakage) says rinse as briefly as possible. This repo previously cited Kapoore in favour of a careful slow wash, which is backwards. PROTEOMIC INPUT: Mueller et al. 2020, doi:10.15252/msb.20199111 (1,000 cells give 500-1,000 proteins).
description: Runs on chip/module6_v1.json, the PROVEN UNIT CELL for one extraction lane at demo scale. Generated by protocols/build_module6.py: do not hand-edit this file. Every volume is derived from the chip's geometry (chamber size, comb path/width/depth, port width and lid thickness) plus the fabrication floors in contracts/blocks.json, and every flow and duration from contracts/parameters.json. THE UNIT IS THE LANE, NOT THE CHAMBER: the field (2.88 uL) sits in series with 4.189 uL upstream (inlet stub + inlet comb) and 4.189 uL downstream (outlet comb + stub), so a lane wetted volume is 11.258 uL and one 'chamber volume' displaces nothing. Exchanges are multiples of the lane volume; the extract that reaches a vial is 7.069 uL (field + downstream). THE LOAD IS CAPPED AT ONE FIELD VOLUME (2.88 uL) and the upstream dead volume is its own PRIME step, which is how the old hand-maintained file's 11.444 uL 'load' into a 2.88 uL chamber (3.97x) is reconciled. The outlet comb is never filled with cell suspension, so cells cannot be stranded past the field. THE PRE-QUENCH RINSE is held to shear.prelysis_rinse_ceiling_dyn_cm2 (0.3 dyn/cm2), the contract value nothing used to read: 58.08 uL/min and about 23 s, against 1.93 uL/min and 712 s on the culture ceiling. Kapoore 2017 found washing itself leaks metabolites, so the shortest defensible rinse is also the right biology; this repo used to cite that paper for a long careful wash, which is backwards. ORDER IS BY PHASE, NOT BY LANE, because the chip has ONE thermal stage over all three fields: seed and culture at 37 C, rinse and flood at 4 C, soak at -20 C, flush and resolubilise at ambient (22 C). One stage cannot hold one lane at -20 C while the others are alive, the stage must not go sub-ambient while a lane holds aqueous rinse buffer, and aqueous solubilisation buffer must not enter a -20 C lane. The old lane-by-lane order broke all three. The soak is 300 s at -20 C (published floor), not 30 s at 4 C; resolubilisation is at ambient, not 37 C, so a carbamylating chaotrope cannot modify peptides during a warm hold. Collect steps carry real durations (22.05 s) instead of 0. PLACEHOLDERS still to fit: attachment, culture duration and interval, resolubilisation time. Reagent names are generic and solvents are named by class; see CONFIDENTIALITY.md.

steps.note: Neurons: PRIME the lane. 4.189 uL of cell suspension fills the inlet stub and the inlet comb - the dead volume UPSTREAM of the field, which the suspension has to cross before a single cell reaches the floor. It is declared here instead of being hidden inside the load, which is how the old file came to claim it was pushing 3.97 chamber volumes into a chamber. Held to the 0.01 dyn/cm2 culture ceiling: these cells have to survive.

Neurons: LOAD exactly one field volume (2.88 uL) of cell suspension, then stop flow so the cells settle onto the coated floor. One field volume is the cap: the suspension front stops at the far field edge and the OUTLET comb is never filled with cells, so cells stranded in the outlet comb are prevented by the volume rather than hoped away by the field-only adhesion coat (which stays untested). Total suspension spent per lane is 7.069 uL, down from one whole wetted volume.

Stop-flow attachment, every port capped, the one thermal stage at 37 C under all three fields. PLACEHOLDER duration.

All three lanes culture in parallel, each through its own port pair: one lane wetted volume (11.258 uL) of fresh medium every interval at the culture-ceiling flow, stop-flow in between. A lane volume, not a field volume, because the comb and the stubs are in series with the field and hold 8.378 uL of the medium. Duration and interval are PLACEHOLDERS. This chip is the extraction unit cell, not a culture chip: at target scale the cells arrive from the module 1 lanes.

Cool the one stage from 37 C to 4 C, every port capped. Derived from thermal.max_ramp_c_per_s and three thermal.tau_s, not guessed. The stage STAYS at 4 C through the quench floods below: taking it to -20 C now would freeze the aqueous rinse buffer in the lanes, which is exactly the slow freeze-quench the comb geometry exists to avoid.

Neurons: pre-quench rinse, 2 lane wetted volumes of ice-cold volatile buffer to waste in about 23 s. Held to shear.prelysis_rinse_ceiling_dyn_cm2 (0.3 dyn/cm2), NOT to the 0.01 culture ceiling: that ceiling exists to keep adherent cells attached for weeks, and against it the same rinse runs at 1.93 uL/min and takes 700 s - twelve minutes of cold perturbation before a quench engineered to take about 1 s. These cells are about to be deliberately killed; losing a few to shear costs nothing, a twelve-minute perturbation costs the measurement. SHORT IS ALSO THE BIOLOGY: Kapoore 2017 found washing itself leaks metabolites, so the rinse should be as brief as it can be while still clearing the medium (Lorenz 2011: a quick rinse roughly doubles detected features).

Neurons: QUENCH FLOOD in place. 2 lane wetted volumes (22.516 uL) of cold acidified organic solvent, free of chlorinated solvents, through the combs in about 1 s at 1351 uL/min. The solvent arrives cold from an off-chip reservoir; the STAGE is still at 4 C. Cells lyse where they sit and the protein precipitates on the floor. No shear ceiling applies from here on. INERTIAL, NOT STOKES: at this flow the feed line runs Re ~ 19 and the comb spine Re ~ 14, so entrance effects and minor losses at the tooth branches are real; only the teeth (Re ~ 2.4) and the field (Re ~ 1.8) are near-creeping. Uniformity rests on TOOTH CONVECTION, not on Re << 1. Outlet at waste; flow then stops.

Every lane now holds organic solvent, so the stage can go sub-ambient without freezing anything: ramp to -20 C, ports capped. THE RIG NEEDS A SUB-AMBIENT SOURCE for this and protocols/thermal_map.md used to say it had none; that contradiction is resolved there.

EXTRACTION SOAK: 300 s stop-flow at -20 C, all three lanes together on the one stage. The old file soaked 30 s at 4 C, which under-extracts and may not form the protein film the resolubilisation step depends on. Published sequential extractions hold the cold organic step for at least 5 min at -20 C (Sapcariu 2014, doi:10.1016/j.mex.2014.07.002; Coman 2016 SIMPLEX, doi:10.1074/mcp.M115.053702); this is that floor, not an optimum. Not a freeze-quench: the quench already happened in the flood.

Neurons: chase. The outlet valve turns to vial M and fresh quench solvent pushes the extract out of out_n. 7.069 uL = the field plus everything downstream of it (outlet comb + stub), which is the honest definition of what reaches the vial. Under the ~10 uL extract-volume design rule, so about 9600 cells land in 7.07 uL, about 1358 cells/uL (ASSUMED 1000 cells/mm2 on the 9.6 mm2 floor).

Neurons: FRACTION 1, the metabolome, plus peptides under about 10 kDa, which do not precipitate. Neutralised on arrival (the vial is pre-charged off chip) and kept on the cold block. Duration is 22.05 s, not 0: two valve actuations, clearing the 1.003 uL outlet stub into the vial, then capping it and moving it. A physical fraction collection takes time, and six steps of this protocol used to claim it took none.

Warm the stage to ambient (22 C), ports capped, BEFORE any aqueous buffer goes in: an aqueous solubilisation buffer pushed into a -20 C lane would freeze in the comb. The protein film is already precipitated, so warming the lane costs nothing.

Neurons: the outlet valve returns to waste and 3 lane wetted volumes (33.774 uL) of solubilisation buffer clear the lane, the port hole and the stub of fraction 1 and displace the organic solvent. Ideal mixing leaves exp(-3) = 5% of the old solvent in the lane (a laminar slot displaces better; unmeasured, to be shown with a dye test). The precipitated protein stays on the floor.

RESOLUBILISATION: stop-flow, 600 s at ambient (22 C), all three lanes. NOT at 37 C, which is what the old file did: a warm hold in a carbamylating chaotrope modifies peptides and blocks identification, so the denaturant class here must be non-carbamylating and the hold is not heated. The '>90% membrane protein recovery after organic precipitation' figure in the literature is specific to COLD ACID resolubilisation, which this is not, so that number is NOT claimed here. The protein is denatured by design: native complexes and enzyme activity are gone, bottom-up identification and quantification are not. PLACEHOLDER duration.

Neurons: chase. The outlet valve turns to vial P and fresh buffer pushes the dissolved protein (7.069 uL) out through the SAME port out_n, at a later time. Separate vials and separate valve positions mean the two fractions never share a vial.

Neurons: FRACTION 2, the proteome, ready for bottom-up digestion. Spin vial M and add its pellet here: the flood may strip fines off the floor film (UNTESTED). The lane is spent. The single-cell transcriptome arm is a different sample path - on this demo chip it is module 4 on capsules; at target scale it is the dissociated fields of the SAME lane.
